items.title: Regulatory Landscape Overview
items.summary: Covers regulatory landscape overview in enterprise GRC.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Covers regulatory landscape overview in enterprise GRC. This lesson focuses on practical understanding, decision-making and evidence-based GRC practice.

sections.heading: Key concepts
sections.body: Core concepts for regulatory landscape overview are explained in plain language, with emphasis on roles, controls, risks and expected outcomes in an enterprise context.

sections.heading: Application
sections.body: Learners should be able to apply the concepts to realistic scenarios, justify decisions, and recognise common gaps or weaknesses.

examples.title: Applying Regulatory Landscape Overview
examples.context: A team must address regulatory landscape overview in a business scenario with limited time and resources.
examples.outcome: A risk-informed, documented decision with clear ownership and follow-up actions.

practicalExercise.title: Exercise: Regulatory Landscape Overview
practicalExercise.brief: Apply the lesson to a fictional organisation facing challenges related to regulatory landscape overview.
practicalExercise.deliverable: A short action plan with rationale.
